The orchard schedule is applied in juniper and crystal shows each instalment. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2005 identities would post 1528 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
